+from scrapy.http import Request

+r2 = Request('http://example.com/page1')
+

+print("Second request seen:", dupefilter.request_seen(r2))
+
+# Test with different requests
+print("\n=== Different Requests Test ===")
+r3 = Request('http://example.com/page2')
+print("Third request (different URL) seen:", dupefilter.request_seen(r3))
+
+# Test with job directory (persistence)
+print("\n=== Persistence Test ===")

+import os

+dupefilter_persistent = RFPDupeFilter(path=temp_dir)

+r5 = Request('http://example.com/page3')
+print("First request to persistent filter:", dupefilter_persistent.request_seen(r4))
